description: Эмблема космической миссии в стиле Васи Ложкина. LoRA lozhkin (Lozhkin_style_Illustrious) на базе NoobAI-XL v1.1 (Illustrious/SDXL, epsilon).
style: lozhkin, Russian pop-art, lubok aesthetic, naive art, crude forms, thick outlines, simple expressive faces, bright contrasting colors, absurd humour, oil on canvas texture, palette knife strokes, visible brushstrokes, satirical, funny, high contrast
suffix: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark
negative: jpeg artifacts, cropped, signature, watermark, text, letters, numbers, words, typography, cyrillic, blurry, low contrast, photorealistic, 3d render, anime screencap, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, cluttered

subjects.emblem: satirical and humorous space mission emblem, circular badge with a thick painted border, centered symmetrical composition, in the center an anthropomorphic ginger striped cat in a retro Soviet spacesuit with a big smile and visible teeth, hugging a small board game box in its paws at chest level, around the cat a diverse team of characters: a middle-aged man with a big nose looking up at the stars with hope, a young schoolboy, two friends, naive bright and slightly absurd cosmic landscape in the background, crude rocket, stars, a planet that looks like a pickle
subjects.patch: satirical and humorous space mission emblem designed as a round embroidered cloth patch, visible thread texture, stitched border, centered symmetrical composition, in the center an anthropomorphic ginger striped cat in a retro Soviet spacesuit grinning with visible teeth and holding a board game box, around it a middle-aged man with a big nose looking up at the stars, a young schoolboy and two friends, crude rocket, bright stars and a pickle-shaped planet in the background
subjects.poster: satirical and humorous space mission emblem as a flat square poster, in the center an anthropomorphic ginger striped cat in a retro Soviet spacesuit with a big smile and visible teeth, holding a board game box, a middle-aged man with a big nose pointing up at the stars, a young schoolboy, two friends, crude rocket, bright stars and a planet that looks like a pickle, naive cosmic landscape
